# `aitbc wallet bridge sell status`

Check the status of a sell quote or lock.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet bridge sell status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--id` | text | — | yes | Quote id, lock id, or lock transaction hash. |
| `--hub-url` | text | — | no | Hub wallet-service base URL — bare origin, path is stripped. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet bridge sell status --id <identifier>
```
